newsitem.title: JAPAN: Mazda to end MX-6 sales in U.S. - paper.
newsitem.headline: Mazda to end MX-6 sales in U.S. - paper.

text.p: Mazda Motor Corp plans to stop selling its MX-6 sports coupe in the North American market and to introduce there a modified version of its 626 sedan, a Japanese business daily reported on Monday.
The Nihon Keizai Shimbun said the company hopes to stem a sales decline in the United States and also try to improve cost efficiency at its North American plant.
A Mazda spokesman was not immediately available to comment on the report.
The modified version of the 626 will have a larger body and more powerful engine, the paper said.
In 1996, Mazda produced 95,700 cars in its North American plant, which is operated by a joint venture with Ford Motor Co, the paper said. Mazda aims to increase production by 20 percent.
